title: Deviled eggs but make them healthy and no mayo
summary: Greek yogurt is the creamy high-protein swap that makes these light, fluffy, and absolutely addictive. Try it for your next snack or party tray!
steps: Did you know if you boil eggs for 10 minutes, cool in an ice bath, peel, slice in half, scoop out those yolks, mix yolks with greek yogurt, mustard, garlic and onion powder, salt and pepper and chopped dill, mash till creamy, then pipe back into egg whites, top with paprika, dill and chill.
caption: Deviled eggs but make them healthy and no mayo! 🥚💛  Greek yogurt is the creamy high-protein swap that makes these light, fluffy, and absolutely addictive.
